name: early-return-fd-leak
title: Early return leaks a descriptor
fix_goal: Avoid returning out of the middle of an ownership scope before cleanup has run.
fix_steps: Find the return that happens after p101_open but before p101_close.
Replace early returns with a common cleanup label or structured cleanup block.
Close the descriptor when it is owned, then clear it to -1.
Re-run ./lab.sh and confirm the early-return descriptor lab is fixed.
lesson: Early returns are convenient, but in C they can jump over cleanup unless ownership is centralized.
